next_issue.title: feat(rc): 3D Rebar Polyline and Mesh Generator for IngeTrazo Viewport
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Implement Task 2 from `JULES_BACKLOG.md`: Generate 3D spatial coordinate polyline points and tubular meshes for rebar visualization in IngeTrazo.

### Tasks
1. Create `chakkree_tools/rc/rebar_mesh.py`
2. Implement standard Thai rebar shapes according to TIS / EIT (วสท. / มอก.):
   - Shape 00: Straight bar (เหล็กเส้นตรง)
   - Shape 21: U-bent bar with hooks for beam main bars (เหล็กนอนดัดฉาก)
   - Shape 41: Rectangular closed stirrup with 135-degree seismic hooks (เหล็กปลอก)
   - Shape 99: Column vertical bar with 90-degree foundation dowel bend (เหล็กยืนเสาฝากฐานราก)
3. Return vertices and line indices ready for IngeTrazo 3D canvas.
4. Add comprehensive unit tests in `tests/test_rebar_mesh.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(ui): Native PySide6 Parametric Dialogs for IngeTrazo Extension
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Implement Task 3 from `JULES_BACKLOG.md`: Provide native, responsive PySide6 dialogs inside IngeTrazo for structural parameters.

### Tasks
1. Create `chakkree_tools/ingetrazo_plugin/ui/footing_dialog.py` (Select 1-9 Piles, pile diameter, rebar sizes, covering).
2. Create `chakkree_tools/ingetrazo_plugin/ui/column_dialog.py` (Section b x h, height, 4-16 longitudinal bars, stirrups).
3. Create `chakkree_tools/ingetrazo_plugin/ui/beam_dialog.py` (Span length, b x h, top/bottom bars, multi-zone stirrups).
4. Wire dialog actions to `plugin.py` to trigger model generation.
5. Add tests in `tests/test_ui_dialogs.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(qto): Automated Bar Bending Schedule (BBS) and Material Take-off Report
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Implement Task 4 from `JULES_BACKLOG.md`: Port quantity take-off formulas from original Chakkree Tools QTO modules.

### Tasks
1. Create `chakkree_tools/qto/bar_schedule.py` calculating cut lengths, hook allowances, and steel weights (kg) for RB6, RB9, DB12, DB16, DB20, DB25, DB28, DB32.
2. Create `chakkree_tools/qto/takeoff.py` for concrete volume, formwork area, lean concrete, and excavation.
3. Add export functions to Markdown table and CSV format.
4. Add unit tests in `tests/test_qto.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(bridge): Live Model Streaming to IngeTrazo via Agent Bridge (Port 8482)
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Implement Task 5 from `JULES_BACKLOG.md`: Enable real-time live streaming of designed models directly into the running IngeTrazo 3D viewport without saving files.

### Tasks
1. Create `chakkree_tools/ingetrazo_plugin/agent_streamer.py`.
2. Send generated `.debim.yaml` manifests via HTTP POST to `http://127.0.0.1:8482`.
3. Add probe listener check and error handling.
4. Add unit tests in `tests/test_agent_streamer.py`.
next_issue.label: jules
